description: This file defines the WrappedHandler struct and associated functions for handling Kubernetes API discovery aggregation, including content negotiation and peer discovery handling.

classes.name: WrappedHandler
classes.description: A handler wrapper for Kubernetes API discovery aggregation, supporting content negotiation and peer discovery.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests, performing media type negotiation and routing to appropriate handlers based on discovery version and profile.

methods.name: restfulHandle
methods.description: Handles RESTful requests by invoking the main ServeHTTP method.

methods.name: GenerateWebService
methods.description: Creates a RESTful web service for API version discovery.
